item.title: Atlassian Agile Project Management Professional Certificate
item.description: I completed the Atlassian Agile Project Management Professional Certificate on LinkedIn Learning. This was a structured learning path made up of six online courses with about 7 hours of content. The certificate is endorsed by Atlassian, a leader in project management and collaboration tools like Jira. By finishing all six courses and passing the final assessment, I earned a professional certificate that I could add to my LinkedIn profile. This helped me improve my project management skills, especially in Agile environments and Jira Software.
